license_note: Meta publishes the weights under the custom Llama 4 Community License, which carries attribution and redistribution duties, a 700 million monthly-active-user commercial threshold, and an incorporated acceptable-use policy. The policy, not the license text, states that the Section 1(a) rights for multimodal Llama 4 models are not granted to individuals domiciled in or companies based in the European Union, so public weights do not make this an open-source distribution.

license_evidence.scope: Llama 4 Maverick 17B 128E Instruct weights, tokenizer, processor configuration, and related Llama materials
Acceptable-use policy and European Union multimodal exclusion incorporated by reference into the Llama 4 Community License

access_boundary: This record represents the meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct BF16 release dated April 5, 2025. The Maverick base model, the separately published FP8 checkpoint, Llama 4 Scout, quantizations, fine-tunes, Meta-hosted products, and independent serving providers are separate model or service boundaries.
strengths: Meta publishes Transformers-compatible Safetensors shards with tokenizer, processor, and chat-template files in one pinned repository
The model card names the governing license, the base model, the release date, and distinguishes the BF16 release from the FP8 and Scout variants
tradeoffs: Artifact access is gated behind identity disclosure and the incorporated policy withholds the multimodal grant from European Union entities
The model card documents a single Transformers path and no hosted serving paths, so other runtimes and operators need independent verification
